CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2420 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 328813ad5fb2055a07a4867c33f7cfc96d961168. Bus nonce: cb60f35e59a9e8d79d6f40191eb086b4. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly; this round's reviewer measures with the finder's harness. Earlier rounds' verdicts are the PR's `Fix review:` comments: say which round this is. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 328813ad5fb2055a07a4867c33f7cfc96d961168`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: <merge|blocked> 328813ad5fb2055a07a4867c33f7cfc96d961168` for merge, or `Fix review: blocked 328813ad5fb2055a07a4867c33f7cfc96d961168 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets) for blocked, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: cb60f35e59a9e8d79d6f40191eb086b4`. Put the evidence in an `ev/` directory beside it, including `ev/HEAD` holding the 40-hex head you measured, under /tmp/seat/rev2420/. Do NOT run bus.sh: the dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, and the orchestrator publishes the verdict there. Return it on a probe ref, and push nothing else: `cd /tmp/seat/rev2420 && rm -rf pr && git init -q pr && cp -r verdict.md ev pr/ && git -C pr add -A && git -C pr -c user.name=hpo-seat -c user.email=hpo-seat@users.noreply.github.com commit -qm "verdict 2420 328813ad5fb2055a07a4867c33f7cfc96d961168" && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer fetch -q /tmp/seat/rev2420/pr HEAD && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer push -q origin FETCH_HEAD:refs/heads/probe/rev-2420-cb60f35e`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except that probe ref. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in the verdict instead.

Context: record PR (branch record/autofix). It adds or rewrites delivery rows under dev/programme/delivery/ for merged PRs. `record_row.py --automerge-check` passes at this head, but the head carries hand-built commits, so it needs a review. Verify every row against the GitHub API (merged state and SHA) and check that `delivery_status.py --check` gives 0 overdue and 0 pending at this head merged with origin/main. Check also that no other file changed beyond rows, and that CI is green.
